name: 16h chunked prefill schedule
title: Chunked prefill on one GPU
subtitle: 7B on one H100: 32 decode streams at 512 tokens of context, a 2,048-token prompt arrives at time 0; prefill at 40% of peak

steps.caption: Before the prompt arrives, each iteration advances 32 streams by one token in 6.59 ms: reading 13.48 GB of weights and 8.6 GB of cache.
Run unchunked, the 2,048-token prompt and the 32 decode tokens share one iteration of 73.6 ms, so every stream waits that long for its next token.
Chunked, iteration 1 carries prompt tokens 1 to 512 plus the 32 decode tokens and takes 18.7 ms. Every stream gets a token.
Iterations 2 and 3 carry tokens 513 to 1,536 and take 19.1 and 19.4 ms. Each later chunk attends to more earlier prompt tokens, which adds about 0.35 ms per chunk.
Iteration 4 finishes the prompt at 76.9 ms, so its first token comes 3.3 ms later than unchunked, while the longest gap the 32 streams see falls from 73.6 to 19.7 ms.
